name: oofy
description: OOFY — Wear Your Confidence. Full-stack e-commerce monorepo (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
